verdict.rationale: Cline ships a JetBrains plugin, and its GitHub README says every edit in JetBrains appears as a diff you can review, modify, or revert, which covers the interactive-diff half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents sharing selected editor code as context from inside JetBrains; the 'same Cline experience' claim is too vague to count. missing for 10: documented selected-code-to-context sharing in JetBrains, detailed JetBrains diff documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of the JetBrains plugin.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE

citations.quote: In VS Code and JetBrains, every edit shows up as a diff you can review, modify, or revert.
The same Cline experience in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, and the rest of the JetBrains family.
